'''Michael Drmota''' (born 17 July 1964 in [[Vienna]]) is an [[Austria]]n [[mathematician]] and professor at  [[TU Wien]].

He studied Mathematics at [[TU Wien]] and finished his PhD in 1986<ref>{{cite web
 |url=https://www.tuwien.at/en/studies/studying-at-tu-wien/promotio-sub-auspiciis
 |title=TU Wien list of Phd graduates ''sub auspiciis praesidentis''
 |access-date=4 January 2021}}</ref> under the supervision of [[Robert F. Tichy]].<ref>{{cite web
 |url=https://mathgenealogy.org/id.php?id=27218
 |title=Tichy's mathgenealogy entry
 |access-date=4 January 2021}}</ref>
At the same university he acquired [[habilitation]] in 1990<ref name="interview">{{cite web
 |url=https://www.tuwien.at/tu-wien/aktuelles/news/news/michael-drmota-mathematikprofessor-am-institut-fuer-diskrete-mathematik-und-geometrie
 |title=TU Wien newsletter 
 |date=16 March 2007
 |access-date=4 January 2021}}</ref>  and is now
full professor<ref name="interview"/> at the [https://dmg.tuwien.ac.at/ Institute of Discrete Mathematics and Geometry], where he also served as head of institute<ref name="interview"/> from 2004 to 2012.

He had visiting professor positions at [[Versailles Saint-Quentin-en-Yvelines University|UVSQ]], [[Pierre and Marie Curie University|University Paris VI]], and [[University of Provence]] (Marseille).
From 2013 until 2019 he was [[Dean (education)|dean]] of the [https://institute.tuwien.ac.at/fakmatgeo/ Faculty of Mathematics and Geoinformation],
from 2010 to 2013 president of the [[Austrian Mathematical Society]].<ref>International Mathematical News [https://www.oemg.ac.at/IMN/imn220.pdf 2011], [https://www.oemg.ac.at/IMN/imn221.pdf 2012], [https://www.oemg.ac.at/IMN/imn222.pdf 2013]. Retrieved 4 January 2021.</ref>  Since 2013 he is corresponding member of the [[Austrian Academy of Sciences]].<ref>{{cite web
 |url=https://www.oeaw.ac.at/mitglieder/gelehrtengesellschaft/klassen/korrespondierende-mitglieder-der-mathematisch-naturwissenschaftlichen-klasse-im-inland
 |title=List of corresponding members in Austria of the Division of Mathematics and the Natural Sciences, Austrian Academy of Sciences
 |access-date=4 January 2021
 |quote=}}</ref>

In 1992 he won the ''Edmund und Rosa Hlawka-Preis'' of the  Austrian Academy of Sciences,<ref>{{cite web|url=https://stipendien.oeaw.ac.at/en/preise/naturwissenschaften/edmund-und-rosa-hlawka-preis-fuer-mathematik/preistraegerinnen|title=List of prize recipients, ÖAW|access-date=4 January 2021}}</ref> and 1996 the [[Prize of the Austrian Mathematical Society]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.oemg.ac.at/Preise.html|title=List of prize recipients, ÖMG|access-date=4 January 2021}}</ref> In 2023, he got awarded the [[Flajolet Lecture Prize]].

His research areas are [[number theory]], [[enumerative combinatorics]],  [[analysis of algorithms]] and [[stochastic process]]es on combinatorial structures.
